title: ODOT Crash Data - 2022 - aggregate summary by area
text:
Aggregate crash summary by area - ODOT Crash Data - 2022 (2022).
- Delaware County: 3,530 crashes (5: 2,505, 3: 480, 4: 441, 2: 87, 1: 17).
- Fairfield County: 2,654 crashes (5: 1,967, 3: 392, 4: 216, 2: 67, 1: 12).
- Franklin County: 22,569 crashes (5: 15,098, 3: 4,082, 4: 2,739, 2: 532, 1: 118).
- Knox County: 1,104 crashes (5: 840, 3: 141, 4: 81, 2: 33, 1: 9).
- Licking County: 3,474 crashes (5: 2,534, 3: 483, 4: 306, 2: 134, 1: 17).
- Madison County: 1,013 crashes (5: 715, 3: 144, 4: 97, 2: 47, 1: 10).
- Morrow County: 864 crashes (5: 649, 3: 143, 4: 41, 2: 22, 1: 9).
- Pickaway County: 1,287 crashes (5: 901, 3: 211, 4: 112, 2: 54, 1: 9).
- Union County: 1,403 crashes (5: 1,069, 3: 154, 4: 129, 2: 44, 1: 7).
- Ohio statewide (all counties; NOT a Central Ohio figure): 265,502 crashes (5: 198,375, 3: 33,458, 4: 26,326, 2: 6,163, 1: 1,180).
Severity is shown as the layer's raw CRASH_SEVERITY_CD codes, which the layer publishes no lookup for; they are not decoded here. Computed on 2026-11-02 by counting records in the ArcGIS layer 'ODOT Crash Data - 2022' grouped by COUNTY_CD, CRASH_YR, CRASH_SEVERITY_CD. Source: https://tims.dot.state.oh.us/ags/rest/services/Safety/2022_Crash_Locations/MapServer/0
caveats: Aggregate counts only, computed server-side; individual crash records are not loaded in this knowledge base.
Severity values are the layer's raw codes (CRASH_SEVERITY_CD); no coded-value domain was published to decode them.
